headline: Bookings that work for African businesses
summary: Share one booking link, set your hours and time off, and manage every appointment in one Goalmatic workspace. Message clients on WhatsApp in a tap, track no-shows, and see what is working. Free, with no commission.

benefits.title: One secure booking link
benefits.description: Guests pick a service and a time in their own timezone, in English or French, and get an instant confirmation with an add-to-calendar file.

benefits.title: WhatsApp-first client messages
benefits.description: Open ready-made confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups in your own WhatsApp, SMS, or email with one tap. Edit the templates to sound like you.

benefits.title: Hours, breaks, and time off
benefits.description: Set several working windows per day, minimum notice, and booking horizon. Block holidays and breaks so guests can never book them.

benefits.title: Know what is working
benefits.description: See booking trends, estimated revenue from your prices, no-show and cancellation rates, busiest times, and returning clients.

benefits.title: No double bookings
benefits.description: Every booking is rechecked before it is confirmed, walk-ins and repeat bookings are clash-checked, and optional Google Calendar flags conflicts.

howItWorks.title: Add your services and hours
howItWorks.description: Set durations, prices in your currency, weekly hours, and any time off.

howItWorks.title: Share your link or QR code
howItWorks.description: Post your booking link on WhatsApp, Instagram, or your website, or print the QR code.

howItWorks.title: Run your day
howItWorks.description: See today and tomorrow at a glance, send reminders, mark appointments completed or no-show, and keep client notes.

prerequisites: Optional: a Google account to connect Google Calendar

faq.question: Does Bookins take payments?
faq.answer: Not yet. Prices are shown to guests and payment is arranged with you directly. Revenue in Insights is an estimate from your display prices.

faq.question: Does Bookins send messages to my clients?
faq.answer: Bookins prepares the message and opens it in your own WhatsApp, SMS, or email app so you send it yourself. There are no per-message fees. Guests see an on-screen confirmation with an add-to-calendar file.

faq.question: Does it work with Google Calendar?
faq.answer: Optionally. Connect Google Calendar to add bookings as events and flag clashes, and to hide your busy times from the booking page.

faq.question: What does it cost?
faq.answer: Bookins is free to install with no commission on bookings. Goalmatic shared credits are used only for metered actions.
